stemMd: A club has 260 dollars for a room costing 80 dollars plus snacks costing 6 dollars per person. What is the greatest whole number of people it can accommodate?
explanationMd: The budget constraint is 80+6n≤260. Thus n≤30. At 30 people the total is exactly 260 dollars; one more person would exceed it.

distractorRationale.d: This is the snack budget in dollars, not the number of people.
distractorRationale.c: This divides the entire budget by 6 and ignores room cost.
distractorRationale.b: This exceeds the budget by 6 dollars.
